/* The following is the KEY-NEXT-ITEM trigger of component_prefix */

 begin
 --
 -- check if the unit process already has a kit defined; if yes,
 -- the screen goes to a edit reagent mode
 --
 begin
 select kit_id into :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id
 from component_sp_reag_hdr
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 component_prefix = :component_prefix and
 process_code = :process_code and
 stage_code = :stage_code;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id := '';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in checking for kit ID');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id is null
 then
 --
 -- unit has not kit defined; therefore, a new kit
 -- will be defined for it
 --
 :GLOBAL.insert_kit := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.new_kit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.edit_kit := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.reagents_expired := 'N';
 --
 -- trying to find the latest set of reagents used for
 -- the process and stage
 --
 begin
 select max(kit_id) into :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id
 from component_sp_reag_hdr
 where process_code = :process_code and
 stage_code = :stage_code and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 --
 -- No reagents for the kit at all
 --
 :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id := '';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error trying to find latest test kit');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id is not null
 then
 --
 -- latest kit found
 --
 go_block('comp_reag_query');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id is null or
 :GLOBAL.reagents_expired = 'Y'
 then
 --
 -- no latest kit found or reagents have expired
 --
 :GLOBAL.insert_kit := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.new_kit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.edit_kit := 'N';
 message
 ('Msg: Reagents has expired or no kit found for process.');
 pause;
 go_block('component_sp_reag_det');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 else
 :GLOBAL.insert_kit := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.edit_kit := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.reagents_expired := 'N';
 --
 -- unit-processs already has reagents defined for it;
 -- therefore, we go to the edit mode
 --
 --message('Msg: Kit already present - entering edit mode.');
 --pause;
 go_block('component_sp_reag_det');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 v_local_time date;

begin
 -- timezone conversion starts
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.expiry_date is not null then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.expiry_date < v_local_time then
 :GLOBAL.reagents_expired := 'Y';
 end if;
 /* 
 if :comp_reag_query.exp_date is not null then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :comp_reag_query.exp_date, :comp_reag_query.exp_date);
 end if;
 */
 ELSE
 if :ctrl_blk_1.expiry_date < sysdate then
 :GLOBAL.reagents_expired := 'Y';
 end if; 
 END IF;
 -- timezone conversion ends
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 message('Msg: Committing reagents.',no_acknowledge);
 begin
 insert into component_sp_reag_hdr
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, component_prefix,
 product_code, process_code, stage_code, insert_dats,

 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :s_chapter_id, :component_prefix,
 :product_code, :process_code, :stage_code, sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id);
 --- timezone conversion 3/4/11
 /* if is_timezone_enabled and (:comp_reag_query.exp_date is not null) then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :comp_reag_query.exp_date, :comp_reag_query.exp_date);

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is
 select reagent_name, manufacturer, lot_number, exp_date
 from component_sp_reag_det
 where kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.kit_id;
begin
 go_block('component_sp_reag_det');
 :GLOBAL.insert_kit := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.new_kit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.edit_kit := 'N';
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :component_sp_reag_det.reagent_name := c1_rec.reagent_name;
 :component_sp_reag_det.manufacturer := c1_rec.manufacturer;
 :component_sp_reag_det.lot_number := c1_rec.lot_number;
 :component_sp_reag_det.exp_date := c1_rec.exp_date;
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_max_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :component_sp_reag_det.exp_date < sysdate
 then
 show_error('4007');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.edit_kit = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 select max(insert_dats)
 into temp_max_date
 from component_sp_reag_hdr
 where kit_id = :component_sp_reag_det.kit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 temp_max_date :=
 :component_sp_reag_det.exp_date+1;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error finding latest date of use of kit');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :component_sp_reag_det.exp_date < temp_max_date
 then
 show_error('0016');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select component_sp.product_code, product_desc from component_sp, valid_products where unit_id = :unit_id and coll_date = :coll_date and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and process_code = :process_code and sysdate between insert_dats and trunc(insert_dats)+365 and substr(component_sp.product_code,1,5) = valid_products.product_code and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_STAGE_CODE_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, code_desc from fr_master_codes where code_type = 'STAG' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and exists (select 'x' from fr_vprocess_stages where process_code = :process_code and stage_code = code and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate))

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_PROCESS_COD_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, code_desc from fr_master_codes where code_type = 'PROC' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
